segments.name: Toy products
segments.description: Designs, develops, tests and sells toy products, from simple plastic toys to electromechanical toys, for customers mainly in Europe and North America.
segments.evidence: We are principally engaged in the design, development, testing and sale of a diverse portfolio of toy products ranging from simple plastic toy products to more complex electromechanical toy products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company fees for toy development services, from design and prototype testing through production management to after-sales services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our solution services span across the entire development stage of toy products from design, prototype testing, production management, quality control to after-sales services.
